name: codexy-devtools
description: Optional Codegraph impact, check-recommendation, and LSP integrations for Codexy.

interface.shortDescription: Add optional Codegraph and LSP tooling to Codexy.
interface.longDescription: Codexy Devtools provides optional local Codegraph structure, read-only change-impact and advisory check-recommendation tools, and language-server integrations for a separately installed Codexy core.
defaultPrompt: Use $codegraph for search, dependency navigation, impact, and check advice when Devtools is installed.
Use $lsp for optional language-aware diagnostics, symbols, definitions, references, and bounded batches.
